comments.content: The new product ID macros break the naming convention used by every other entry in this header (all-uppercase, e.g. `USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_ULTIMATE2_WIRELESS`): `USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_SN30_Pro`, `USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_SF30_Pro`, `USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_Pro_2` and `USB_PRODUCT_8BITDO_Pro_2_BT` mix cases. The comments also carry trailing whitespace and are cryptic ("B + START", "mode switch to D"). Please rename to `..._SN30_PRO`, `..._SF30_PRO`, `..._PRO_2`, `..._PRO_2_BT` (and update the two usages in `SDL_joystick.c` / `SDL_hidapi_8bitdo.c`), and spell out the mode note.
